# Build2234 guarded Actions publisher

This tooling-only branch is based on the unchanged production baseline. The existing registered canonical workflow is dispatched on this frozen ref; it does not require a preliminary merge into main or deploy any tooling. Preparation requires the exact approved source PR, all12 hosted checks, both ten-gate canonical records, original artifact and release manifests, checksummed prior attempts and an unchanged production main. The plan remains explicitly unfinalized until every mandatory record is verified.

Only the normal authorized Actions GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:write uploads evidence. Preparation attaches and reads back a draft without merging or tagging. After independently checking the preparation certificate, use the ordinary expected-head PR squash merge. Publication requires the merge tree to equal the validated source, the same frozen publisher/preparation, unchanged main and approved source; it then creates the correct immutable tag/release, checks every attachment and verifies deployed identity and bounded public/authentication-boundary smoke. No direct Cloud upload, new credential, provider acquisition or production preference change is used.
